tag: Story · outdoor walls above the sea
note: The tutorial region. It teaches instead of testing: fights, one gentle parkour room, a first lever puzzle. No trial; a hard trial before you have any abilities would just be a wall.

rooms.name: The Long Wall
rooms.idea: A sweeping rampart walk with collapsed sections and archers on the towers. High route along the battlements, low route through the stables.

rooms.name: The Stable Yard
rooms.idea: Collapsed stables with archers in the hayloft and loose horses’ bones underfoot.

rooms.name: Signal Tower Stair
rooms.idea: A vertical climb up a signal tower, soldiers on each landing.

rooms.name: The Barracks
rooms.idea: Bunks, weapon racks and the first shield wardens. Teaches blocking and parrying on the way.

rooms.name: Siege Undercroft
rooms.idea: Dark tunnels under the wall down toward the Catacombs, with a lift that opens a shortcut back to the first shrine.

rooms.name: Crenel Run
rooms.idea: Hop broken battlements over a sheer drop. Wide gaps and slow crumbling: a gentle first taste.

rooms.name: Winch House
rooms.idea: Two winches each hold the portcullis for a few seconds. Hit one, sprint, hit the other.

rooms.name: Muster Yard
rooms.idea: Strike the war banner and the gates slam shut: three waves of soldiers, then a shield warden.

rooms.name: Watcher’s Perch
rooms.idea: A bench on the highest tower. The camera pulls back over the Hallow with the Pale Root on the horizon. Lore: the night the ash fell.

rooms.name: Sentry’s Cache
rooms.idea: Behind a cracked wall in the Long Wall: your first breakable wall.

note: Tight, dark and full of hiding places, so it leans on secrets and close fights. There is no view underground, so no vista; the only big room is a natural cavern.

rooms.name: The Great Ossuary
rooms.idea: A cavern of bone shelves on three levels, with root-crawler nests and a hidden upper gallery.

rooms.name: Rootbound Passage
rooms.idea: Roots have split the walls; crawlers drop from the ceiling.

rooms.name: The Drop Shaft
rooms.idea: A descent down ledges and old coffin shelves.

rooms.name: Burial Tunnels
rooms.idea: Low tunnels lined with niches; things crawl out of them.

rooms.name: Bone Lift Shaft
rooms.idea: Ride rising and falling bone lifts between spike walls.

rooms.name: Crypt of Lanterns
rooms.idea: Light the lanterns in the order carved on the tombs to open the vault.

rooms.name: Charnel Pit
rooms.idea: Ring the bone bell at the pit’s edge to call up waves of rot crawlers, then a grave knight.

rooms.name: Gravedigger’s Stash
rooms.idea: A false tomb in the Burial Tunnels.

rooms.name: The Sealed Niche
rooms.idea: Under a slam-cracked floor in the Ossuary.

note: Tall and sacred: climbing, a hymn puzzle and the game’s first real view. The double jump is found here, so its trial tests the double jump right away.

rooms.name: The Clerestory
rooms.idea: The cathedral’s upper storey: rafters, stained-glass walls, three routes between the nave and the bell tower.

rooms.name: Pilgrims’ Aisle
rooms.idea: Rows of kneeling statues. A few of them are not statues.

rooms.name: Flooded Crypt Stair
rooms.idea: A stair down into knee-deep black water under the nave.

rooms.name: Confessional Row
rooms.idea: Enemies wait inside the booths and ambush you as you pass.

rooms.name: Chandelier Crossing
rooms.idea: Chandeliers sway when you land and drop if you stay too long.

rooms.name: Organ Loft
rooms.idea: Pull the organ stops in the order of the hymn written in the choir book.

rooms.name: The Rose Window
rooms.idea: Sit beneath the great window: light shafts, the choir humming, the story of the Pale Root church.

rooms.name: Bellrope Trial
rooms.idea: Climb swinging bell ropes to the top before the bell tolls three times.

rooms.name: The Walled Sacristy
rooms.idea: Behind the altar, through a breakable wall.

note: Hostile ground and nothing worth hiding. Hazard parkour and a fight, with one lonely rest stop. No trial and no secret: the swamp itself is the challenge.

rooms.name: The Drowned Grove
rooms.idea: A poison marsh of islands, rotted trees and sinking lily pads. Bog spitters guard the dry ground.

rooms.name: Boardwalk of Stilts
rooms.idea: Rickety boardwalks above the poison, with gaps and ambushes from the water.

rooms.name: The Reed Maze
rooms.idea: Tall reeds hide enemies until they’re close.

rooms.name: Sinking Stones
rooms.idea: Stepping stones sink after half a second. Keep moving.

rooms.name: Rotwood Bridges
rooms.idea: Rope bridges that snap behind you as you cross.

rooms.name: The Valve House
rooms.idea: Two valves raise and lower the poison water to open the high exit or the low one.

rooms.name: Leech Pits
rooms.idea: Kick the rotten stake and the pit wakes: bog spitters from above, a mire witch across the water.

rooms.name: Fisherman’s Rest
rooms.idea: A dry hut on stilts, a lantern and fog over the marsh. Kalden’s old letter is on the table.

note: A library, so it’s the puzzle region. The Root Hook is found here, so its trial is a hook trial. No gauntlet: it’s a quiet place.

rooms.name: The Grand Stacks
rooms.idea: Towering shelves, rolling ladders that slide along rails, and hook points high up.

rooms.name: The Copy Room
rooms.idea: Desks of scribes still copying pages, turned hollow at their work.

rooms.name: Ladder Well
rooms.idea: A shaft of ladders and shelves between floors of the library.

rooms.name: Page Storm
rooms.idea: Gusts lift loose pages into platforms for a moment.

rooms.name: The Index Room
rooms.idea: Pull the books whose numbers match the index card to open a hidden shelf.

rooms.name: The Cipher Wall
rooms.idea: Decode the scribe’s cipher from notes scattered across the Archives, then strike the matching glyphs.

rooms.name: Reading Nook
rooms.idea: A window seat with candles and rain on the glass. The scribe’s notes on the Unwritten.

rooms.name: Hookline Trial
rooms.idea: Swing hook to hook over an ink abyss without landing.

rooms.name: Forbidden Annex
rooms.idea: Behind a false bookcase.

note: Momentum and slipping: ice is the parkour tool. The Ember Dash is found here, so its trial is built for the dash. The cold leaves little to fight.

rooms.name: The Frozen Falls
rooms.idea: Climb a frozen waterfall while icicles fall. Ice ledges slide under you.

rooms.name: Pump Station
rooms.idea: Frozen pumps and pipes, with slick floors and frost soldiers.

rooms.name: Frozen Conduit
rooms.idea: A cramped run through the inside of an iced-over pipe.

rooms.name: The Long Slide
rooms.idea: A long slippery ice run with gaps. Build speed and time the jumps.

rooms.name: Icicle Gallery
rooms.idea: Icicles drop as you pass under them; some make new footholds when they land.

rooms.name: Brazier Locks
rooms.idea: Light and douse braziers to melt or freeze the water into platforms.

rooms.name: Frostbitten Overlook
rooms.idea: A bench above the still reservoir under an aurora.

rooms.name: Rimebreaker Trial
rooms.idea: Ember-dash through ash veils in mid-air while timing the icicles.

tag: Story · sea wall, wind and lightning
note: The traversal region: the most parkour in the story, wind everywhere and a view of the sea. No puzzles and no gauntlet: the storm is the enemy.

rooms.name: The Storm Causeway
rooms.idea: A long broken causeway with lightning that marks where it will strike, and wind that pushes you.

rooms.name: Fishers’ Row
rooms.idea: Huts along the sea wall, wind rattling the shutters.

rooms.name: Sea-Wall Tunnels
rooms.idea: Storm drains inside the wall, with waves crashing through the grates.

rooms.name: The Lower Harbor
rooms.idea: Docks and hanging nets, with a shortcut back up the sea wall.

rooms.name: Updraft Chimney
rooms.idea: Ride the updrafts up a chimney between crumbling blocks.

rooms.name: The Crumbling Stair
rooms.idea: A spiral stair falling apart around you as you climb.

rooms.name: Kite Lines
rooms.idea: Cross a gorge on the lines of storm kites; the wind swings them.

rooms.name: Lighthouse Balcony
rooms.idea: The storm over the open sea, seen from the top of the sea wall.

rooms.name: The Last Field ✦
rooms.idea: Hidden. After Cindervane falls, a passage opens in the Stormspire onto a golden wheat field at sunset: her nest, her story and the Ember Hatchling spell. Details below.

rooms.name: Gale Trial
rooms.idea: Glide through gaps between the lightning strikes.

rooms.name: The Crow’s Nest
rooms.idea: Far above the Stormspire, reached only by gliding.

note: An industrial hell: machines, heat and workers who fight back. Two gauntlets and a lava chase, and no vista: nothing down here is peaceful.

rooms.name: The Great Forge
rooms.idea: Conveyor belts, lava geysers and moving crane hooks across a huge foundry floor.

rooms.name: Ore Rail Tunnels
rooms.idea: Mine tunnels where runaway ore carts come through.

rooms.name: Workers’ Lift
rooms.idea: A freight lift shaft with platforms on chains.

rooms.name: Belt Runner
rooms.idea: Belts over the lava reverse direction on a timer.

rooms.name: Slag Sluices
rooms.idea: Open channels to route molten slag. It cools into the platforms you need.

rooms.name: The Slag Pits
rooms.idea: Pull the shift whistle: forge workers and acolytes pour in on the shifting belts.

rooms.name: The Overseer’s Floor
rooms.idea: Sound the foundry horn to bring out the guards and a slag golem, with the belts running.

rooms.name: Crucible Trial
rooms.idea: Climb while the lava rises behind you.

rooms.name: The Slam-cracked Vault
rooms.idea: Under a cracked floor in the Great Forge.

note: The finale. Short and focused: one great climb, one last view and the story’s hardest trial. No puzzles to slow the ending down.

rooms.name: The Great Boughs
rooms.idea: Climb the Pale Root’s branches: falling petals and a view of everything below.

rooms.name: The Root Passage
rooms.idea: A tunnel through the living wood of the Pale Root.

rooms.name: Petal Stair
rooms.idea: A climb up bark ledges under falling petals.

rooms.name: Petal Drift
rooms.idea: Giant petals drift on the wind as moving platforms.

rooms.name: Thorned Gallery
rooms.idea: Touch the thorned idol to call the sentinels’ echoes, one after another.

rooms.name: The Crown Overlook
rooms.idea: The whole Hallow below you. The last lore before the Sovereign.

rooms.name: Sovereign’s Trial
rooms.idea: One run that needs every technique: hook, dash, glide and slam. The best charm in the story regions.

note: A living forest: vines to swing on, witches in the trees, a glade to rest in. Paths through the forest instead of puzzles.

rooms.name: The Elder Canopy
rooms.idea: Treetop walkways, bramble walls and hanging vines between huge trunks.

rooms.name: The Hunter’s Trail
rooms.idea: An old hunting trail with rusted snares and deer skulls.

rooms.name: Under the Roots
rooms.idea: A path beneath the great trees, lit by glowing fungus.

rooms.name: Vine Swing
rooms.idea: Swing from vine to vine over a thorn floor.

rooms.name: The Coven Circle
rooms.idea: Step into the ring of standing stones to start the witches’ rite; thorns rise from the ground.

rooms.name: Mossbed Glade
rooms.idea: Fireflies, soft moss and a bench under an ancient tree.

rooms.name: Bramble Sprint
rooms.idea: A pogo run across the brambles, against the clock.

rooms.name: Witch’s Larder
rooms.idea: Behind a thorn wall the Ember Dash burns through.

note: Swimming is the parkour here. Water-level puzzles and a light-filled lagoon; no gauntlet, because fights underwater get old fast.

rooms.name: The Sunken Nave
rooms.idea: A flooded church with air pockets; swim routes and dry routes cross.

rooms.name: Grave Causeway
rooms.idea: A half-flooded causeway between burial mounds.

rooms.name: Tomb Galleries
rooms.idea: Rows of sealed tombs, some of them leaking.

rooms.name: Tide Steps
rooms.idea: The water rises and falls on a cycle, opening and closing the routes.

rooms.name: The Floodgates
rooms.idea: Three gates set the water level across three chambers.

rooms.name: Pearl Lagoon
rooms.idea: Light through the water, drifting pearls and a sunken bench.

rooms.name: Breathless Dive
rooms.idea: A swim course that has to be done on one breath.

rooms.name: The Drowned Bell
rooms.idea: Down a well no one has opened.

note: A mystery house: riddles, locked rooms and secret passages, plus the staff who serve the Countess. No trial: this manor is about exploring, not platforming.

rooms.name: The East Wing
rooms.idea: Three floors of manor: galleries, servants’ stairs and a collapsed library.

rooms.name: The Grand Staircase
rooms.idea: The manor’s central stair, portraits watching every landing.

rooms.name: Servants’ Corridor
rooms.idea: Narrow hidden halls behind the manor’s walls.

rooms.name: Blood-Rain Rooftops
rooms.idea: Slick rooftops and chimneys in the red rain.

rooms.name: The Portrait Riddle
rooms.idea: The painted eyes follow a sequence. Pull the matching frames.

rooms.name: The Locked Study
rooms.idea: Find three keys hidden around the manor to open the Count’s study.

rooms.name: Servants’ Quarters
rooms.idea: Ring the service bell and the household staff answer, all turned.

rooms.name: Moonlit Conservatory
rooms.idea: Glass roof, dead roses and a piano that plays itself.

rooms.name: Behind the Bookcase
rooms.idea: A secret passage from the library into the walls.

tag: Side · city of the dead, bells
note: Grim and martial: the dead army fights, the bells rule the ground, the headsman’s axes swing. No vista: there is nothing restful here.

rooms.name: The Catafalque Stair
rooms.idea: A giant stair of tombs climbing to the Hollow Throne.

rooms.name: Street of Lanterns
rooms.idea: A street of tombs lit by ghost lanterns.

rooms.name: The Cemetery Gate
rooms.idea: The walled approach to the city, guarded by the dead.

rooms.name: The Bellwalk
rooms.idea: Each toll of the bell swaps which stones are solid.

rooms.name: The Dirge
rooms.idea: Ring the bells in the order of the funeral dirge on the wall.

rooms.name: The Legion Yard
rooms.idea: Beat the war drum to call rank after rank of the dead king’s soldiers.

rooms.name: Charnel Barracks
rooms.idea: Take the headsman’s axe from its rack and the barracks wake: headsmen and chain-wielders.

rooms.name: Headsman’s Run
rooms.idea: A corridor of swinging executioner’s axes.

rooms.name: Ossuary of Kings
rooms.idea: Beneath the throne room.

note: Treasure-hunting country: buried tombs, hieroglyph puzzles and two secrets under the sand. An oasis to rest at; no gauntlet in the open desert.

rooms.name: The Sea of Dunes
rooms.idea: Slopes, quicksand and a sandstorm that hides the path.

rooms.name: Caravan Road
rooms.idea: Wrecked caravans half buried in the sand, with scarabs nesting in them.

rooms.name: Tomb Entry Hall
rooms.idea: The painted hall leading down into the tombs.

rooms.name: Sinking Sands
rooms.idea: Quicksand swallows what you stand on. Keep jumping.

rooms.name: The Sun Dial
rooms.idea: Turn mirrors to carry sunlight to the hieroglyph door.

rooms.name: The Hieroglyph Seal
rooms.idea: Match the pharaoh’s titles carved in the halls to open the seal.

rooms.name: The Last Oasis
rooms.idea: Palms, still water and the sunset.

rooms.name: Sandfall Descent
rooms.idea: Fall down a shaft of sandfalls without touching the walls.

rooms.name: The Nameless Tomb
rooms.idea: Buried under a dune; slam through.

rooms.name: Scarab Cache
rooms.idea: Follow the golden scarab into a crack in the sandstone.

tag: Side · black glass and fallen stars
note: The contemplative region: floaty parkour, starlight puzzles and two views of the sky. Nothing here to fight in waves.

rooms.name: The Glass Expanse
rooms.idea: A black-glass plain with star tiles and craters to cross.

rooms.name: Observatory Road
rooms.idea: The old pilgrims’ road up to the observatory.

rooms.name: Glass Canyon
rooms.idea: A canyon of black glass that reflects the stars.

rooms.name: Meteor Steps
rooms.idea: Stepping stones made of falling meteors.

rooms.name: Gravity Wells
rooms.idea: Star shards pull you toward them as you jump past.

rooms.name: The Lens Array
rooms.idea: Turn lenses to bend starlight onto three sockets.

rooms.name: The Stargazer’s Seat
rooms.idea: A meteor shower behind the old observatory.

rooms.name: The Crater Edge
rooms.idea: The whole crater and the fallen star’s glow below.

rooms.name: Moonstep Trial
rooms.idea: A tower that needs the triple jump.

rooms.name: The Comet’s Heart
rooms.idea: Inside the crater’s core.

note: A city built for movement: the most parkour of any side region, a security lockdown and a rooftop view.

rooms.name: The Megablock
rooms.idea: A vertical city block with elevators, billboards and data abysses.

rooms.name: Back Alleys
rooms.idea: Rain, vending machines and gangs of glitched hollows.

rooms.name: Service Tunnels
rooms.idea: Maintenance tunnels with steam vents and cable trays.

rooms.name: Data Highway
rooms.idea: Jump between moving maglev cars.

rooms.name: Billboard Climb
rooms.idea: Climb flickering billboards; the dark ones aren’t solid.

rooms.name: Firewall
rooms.idea: Terminals toggle laser gates. Find the route that stays open.

rooms.name: Security Lockdown
rooms.idea: Trip the alarm terminal: shutters seal and waves of drones pour in.

rooms.name: Neon Skyline
rooms.idea: A rooftop in the rain with billboards and flying traffic.

rooms.name: Glitch Run
rooms.idea: Platforms de-render on the beat of the music.

rooms.name: The Dev Room
rooms.idea: A glitched room with a joke or two and a real reward.

note: The hidden end of the world: a lonely approach, a last warm place and the game’s hardest trial.

rooms.name: The Ashen Expanse
rooms.idea: An endless field of ash and old embers on the way to the Hollow.

rooms.name: The Cinder Road
rooms.idea: The last road, lined with burnt-out shrines.

rooms.name: The Last Hearth
rooms.idea: The only warm place left in the Hallow.

rooms.name: Trial of the First Flame
rooms.idea: The hardest trial in the game. Every technique, no mistakes.

note: A small reward for finding Oswin: somewhere to sit, and his stash.

rooms.name: The Hermit’s Garden
rooms.idea: Oswin’s wind chimes and herb garden.

rooms.name: The Hidden Path
rooms.idea: The approach to Oswin’s hut through the fog.

rooms.name: Oswin’s Stash
rooms.idea: Under the floorboards of his hut.
